authorization_scope: Static content admission only. This report neither performs nor authorizes Git, upload, execution, native restore/save/Query/Teach, SDK, Action, runtime adoption, or authority changes.

scope_freeze.note: The review allowlist is a separate scope-control file. It and this admission report are not counted among the 258 content files. Historical pending statuses are preserved unchanged; the later independent outcome PASS is a separate record.

inspection_method.mode: Read-only source/text and complete inert JSON inspection; stdlib-only audit helpers; no inspected program was imported or executed.
inspection_method.source_syntax: 111 listed Python source files were parsed as AST only; source revisions and test fixtures were semantically inspected as archival code.
inspection_method.json_files: 46 listed .json files parsed; complete native typed state JSON, record JSON, and diagnostic JSON parsed separately.
inspection_method.native_types: __辞書__ and __組__ wrappers were traversed into ordinary Python data solely for equality checks. __データ型__ and __列挙__ names stayed inert tags. No native type was instantiated.
inspection_method.streaming: File SHA256 and unused tails checked in 64 KiB chunks. No extraction, bulk copy, or opaque official/game/SDK dependency read.
inspection_method.external_dependency_policy: External native/input paths in manifests were treated only as pinned provenance references. Their bodies were not opened by this inspector. The retained normal state matches the baseline pin, and the separate independent outcome reviewer reports verification of all external pins.

content_safety.basis: All 258 content files were scanned for common private-key, API-key, cloud-access-key, GitHub-token, and bearer-token signatures; no hits. All non-reserve files are readable UTF-8 source/text/JSON. Reserve bodies are fully accounted for by checked JSON or zero tails.
content_safety.credential_scan_limitation: This is a bounded content review and signature scan, not a universal proof that arbitrary strings cannot encode a secret.

preserved_bootstrap_diagnostics.interpretation: The initial bootstrap HOLD and subsequent BINDING_PASS_NO_CALLS are both retained. Neither is a Query, Teach, save, or gameplay result.

independent_review.note: Growth/caller pure-test results, bootstrap checks, executed native evidence, and later outcome audit remain distinct stages. Test counts are not learning/game performance.

preservation_limitations: Initial preparation source files were edited in place before systematic version retention; complete original pre-fix sources were not retained, as disclosed in preparation_history.md. Later retained versions and every available failure byte remain admitted unchanged.
freeze_attempt01_failure.txt retains the parse failure and an explicitly reconstructed typo fragment, not a preserved full original failed inline script.
Review history retains initial assertion/test failures and final corrected code. Complete original versions of every inline/pre-fix reviewer script are not claimed.
Historical README/config/admission/pending-status records represent their time of creation and are not silently rewritten to later PASS.

Native state writer truncation can release physical preallocation. Known-writer length bounds and free-space checks do not guarantee retention against arbitrary ENOSPC, I/O failure, kernel failure, or machine death.
Actual CPU seconds were not separately recorded. Unknown-frontier failures forbid automatic resumption.
claim_limits: Before teaching all six goal replies were native 状態=出力 with no prediction, not native HOLD.
After teaching the six labels F,F,F,F,T,T are retrieval on the same four distinct training conditions, with duplicates retained.
Six historical observations are newly introduced only to this descendant; zero new independent environmental observations were collected.
Principle records 16→19 means one new deterministic-correspondence lineage with three versions, not three independent rules.
False endpoint outcomes are retained negative outcomes and are not automatically refutations of the learned correspondence; native refutation lists remain empty.
The 13 smoke comparisons establish equality of selected outcome fields only; all whole raw replies differ, including state version, query references, and global active-principle listing.

Fixed geometry/mask and role assumptions, endpoint-score labels, and 77 unknown phases remain limitations. No held-out/generalization/causal-necessity/continuous-preservation/geometry-correctness/fresh-instance/cross-game/full-game/safe-Action claim is admitted.
No exhaustive prior-success regression or runtime adoption is established. Strategy remains null and automatic transition false.
